caption: The drawing is on a beige or off-white background and rendered in fine pencil or ink lines. At the top center, the words “Anna Bleecker” are written in an ornate script with the date "Feb 22, 1856" underneath in smaller cursive writing. On either side of this name, near the upper corners, the words "HUTTON" and "ALBANY" are printed in capital letters. Below the text, there is a decorative shield or crest at the center of the composition. The shield contains the outline of a bird perched on a branch. Emerging from the top of the shield is a small animal, possibly a squirrel or a similar mammal, depicted standing on its hind legs. Floral and leafy vines frame the shield, arching out to the left and right with roses and clusters of small flowers interspersed among the foliage. At the bottom left in cursive is the name "C. W. Smith Bleecker," and on the bottom right in cursive is "B. B. Bleecker." The artist’s name, "Hester Douws," appears in small, neat lettering at the lower right corner. The entire drawing is centered within a faint rectangular border. The lines and text are all rendered in a handwritten or hand-drawn style, with no areas of heavy shading or coloration other than the monochrome line work.
title: Silver Flagon
